# Criteria (CRITERIA — Creative Studio)

> Criteria (also searched as CRITERIA Creative Studio or Criterea) is a multidisciplinary creative design and software studio operating on a pay-after-preview model. Clients receive a custom watermarked design preview or interactive wireframe within 24–48 hours before paying.

- Official Website: https://criteriaa.web.app/
- Create a Project (Client Brief Portal): https://criteriaa.web.app/submit
- CritSpace (Interactive 2D/3D Workspace): https://criteriaa.web.app/critspace
- Contact Email: helpcriteria@gmail.com
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/helpcriteria-bit/CRITERIA

## Core Value Proposition: Pay-After-Preview Model
1. **Create a Project (`/submit`)**: Clients submit a 5-step project brief (Name, Project Type, Details, Budget, Review) with or without an account.
2. **Free Watermarked Preview (24–48 Hours)**: Criteria's design and engineering team produces a custom watermarked visual concept, wireframe, or prototype.
3. **Risk-Free Approval**: Clients only pay once they review and approve the preview. Upon payment, full unwatermarked deliverables and source code are unlocked via the client dashboard.

## Services Offered
- **Custom Websites & Full-Stack Web Apps**: Bespoke marketing sites, e-commerce storefronts, and full-stack web applications using modern HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, and Firebase cloud infrastructure.
- **Logo & Brand Identity**: Complete visual identities, wordmarks, icons, color systems, and typography guidelines.
- **UI/UX & Product Design**: Wireframes, interactive prototypes, and design systems for web and mobile apps.
- **Posters & Graphics**: Event posters, social media campaigns, print artwork, and brand graphics.
- **Thumbnails & Creator Assets**: High-converting YouTube thumbnails, podcast covers, and creator branding.
- **Motion Graphics & Video Editing**: Animated logos, promotional reels, and video post-production.

## Platform Features
- **CritSpace (`/critspace`)**: A browser-based 2D canvas (Fabric.js) and 3D workspace (Three.js) for visual ideation and PDF export.
- **Client Dashboard (`/dashboard`)**: Authenticated portal for tracking project status, reviewing watermarked previews, communicating with agents, and downloading final assets.
- **Built-in AI Assistant**: Real-time on-site AI chat widget (`ai-chat.js`) to help visitors scope projects and answer studio questions.
